args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — main article + subscriber companion
args.body:
• Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
• Companion piece (subscriber access): pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.

Sources: blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain; insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion (accessed with team subscription code SUB-5903).
